scope: Local FastAPI and Postgres with Caddy forward-auth; not an AWS or public HTTPS verification

checks.browser_login: Wrong password rejected, login succeeds, session survives reload, sign-out revokes persisted cookie
checks.ingress: Anonymous BI API returns 401; BI HTML redirects to login; signed-in BI health returns 200; replayed cookie after logout returns 401
checks.real_superset: Six embedded chart responses successful; medians and cohort counts match Postgres; 30/60-day and upstream/fork/dependency filters pass
checks.layout: Desktop and mobile login screenshots visually reviewed; no horizontal overflow at 390px
checks.backend: Expiry, password rotation, operator separation, CSRF, durable rate limits and password-hash concurrency covered by automated tests
